steps.en: Driver details furnished by the owner or hirer are recorded
steps.id: Data driver dari owner atau hirer dicatat

steps.en: The system counts earlier offences of the same kind under the driver's ID
steps.id: Sistem menghitung offence sejenis sebelumnya atas ID driver
steps.why_en: No counting of earlier offences per driver exists anywhere in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penghitungan offence sebelumnya per driver di sistem.

steps.en: The system checks the result against the set conditions to pick composition or court
steps.id: Sistem mencocokkan hasilnya dengan syarat yang ditetapkan untuk memilih composition atau court
steps.why_en: No rule choosing between composition and court exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan yang memilih antara composition dan court di sistem.

steps.en: When composition applies, the notice moves to the first demand stage at the composition amount
steps.id: Bila composition berlaku, notice masuk tahap demand pertama dengan jumlah composition
steps.why_en: Every driver takes this path; no condition decides it.
steps.why_id: Semua driver masuk jalur ini; tidak ada syarat yang menentukannya.

steps.en: When the conditions call for court, the notice is taken to court
steps.id: Bila syarat mengarah ke court, notice dibawa ke court
steps.why_en: A notice reaches court only by the fixed reminder ladder or a staff move, not by a rule.
steps.why_id: Notice sampai ke court hanya lewat tangga reminder tetap atau pindah manual staf, bukan lewat aturan.

steps.en: Follow-up steps then run on their own along the set workflow
steps.id: Tindakan lanjutan lalu berjalan otomatis sesuai alur yang ditetapkan
steps.why_en: The letter run is started by hand; the daily schedule does not call it.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman surat dijalankan manual; jadwal harian tidak memanggilnya.
